nodes.body:
Chloé fragrances are soft, natural-feeling florals: rose, freesia, jasmine and plum over woods and moss, rather than sugar or heavy spice. The Nomade line has grown into a small family of its own, and the Naturelle scents put a single flower at the centre. Here is every Chloé perfume we stock, with its notes, the sizes on offer and who each one suits.

Chloé Nomade

Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum (£55.74, 50ml) is a floral chypre: Mirabelle plum at the top, freesia in the heart and oakmoss in the base. The plum gives it a soft, fruity start, and the oakmoss keeps it dry and grown-up rather than sweet. It is an easy everyday scent for the office and weekends, in any season.

For a gift, the Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£83.99) holds a 75ml bottle and a 20ml travel spray for the handbag.

Nomade Nuit d'Égypte

Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte Eau de Parfum (£55.99, 50ml) is the warm, spicy member of the family. Myrrh, ginger, cinnamon, broom flower nectar, cypriol and opopanax open it; orange blossom absolute fills the heart; and vanilla sits underneath. Resinous and glowing, it suits evenings, autumn and winter, and anyone who finds the original Nomade too light.

Nomade Jasmin Naturel Intense

Chloé Nomade Jasmin Naturel Intense Eau de Parfum (from £55.99, 50ml or 75ml) keeps Nomade's Mirabelle plum and adds date, with Egyptian jasmine at its heart and vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli in the base. Richer and creamier than Nomade, it is a jasmine scent for cooler days and evenings.

Rose Naturelle Intense

Chloé Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum (£52.99, 50ml) is a rose scent with a woody edge: bergamot and neroli at the top, rose and oakwood in the heart, sandalwood and vanilla in the base. Fresh at first, then a warm, natural-smelling rose. A good choice for anyone who loves rose but wants it clean rather than powdery.

The Chloé miniature sets

The signature Chloé Eau de Parfum and Chloé Rose Tangerine are in our miniature sets, which are also the easiest way to try the range:

  • Chloé Women's Miniature Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£52.99): Chloé Eau de Parfum 20ml (peony, lychee, freesia, rose, magnolia, cedarwood and amber) and Nomade Eau de Parfum 20ml.
  • Chloé Women's Miniature Perfume Set (£47.99): four 5ml bottles: Nomade Eau de Toilette (lychee, freesia, oakmoss), Rose Tangerine Eau de Toilette (tangerine, rose, blackcurrant, cedarwood), Chloé Eau de Parfum and Nomade Eau de Parfum.

Which Chloé perfume should you choose?

  • A soft, mossy everyday floral: Nomade.
  • Something warm and spicy for evenings: Nomade Nuit d'Égypte.
  • A creamy jasmine: Nomade Jasmin Naturel Intense.
  • A clean, natural rose: Rose Naturelle Intense.
  • The signature Chloé rose and peony: the 20ml duo set.
  • Not sure yet: the 4 x 5ml set lets you try four scents first.

If you love rose with a soft, powdery edge, Lalique Perles Eau de Parfum (£31.99, 100ml) pairs Bulgarian rose and orris with Bourbon pepper and patchouli over cashmere wood and tonka bean. It is a different perfume, warmer than the Chloé roses.

Good to know

  • Eau de parfum or eau de toilette? Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.
  • Buying a gift? See our mini perfume sets guide and perfume gift sets guide.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

Shop every Chloé fragrance, or browse perfume for women and perfume gift sets for her.

Dolce & Gabbana fragrances lean warm and Mediterranean: Sicilian citrus, orange blossom and spice over tobacco, amber and woods. The One is the line most people search for, but the house also makes the fresh, herbal K for men and the sweet Devotion and fruity Q for women. Here is every Dolce & Gabbana perfume we stock, with its notes, the sizes on offer and who each one suits.

The One for Men: three versions

The One for Men comes in three strengths with different notes, so it is worth knowing which is which:

  • The One for Men Eau de Parfum (£66.54, 100ml, or 150ml at £80.99): grapefruit, coriander and basil, then cardamom, ginger and orange blossom, over tobacco, amber and cedarwood. Spicy and warm, with a smooth tobacco base.
  • The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense (£70.14, 100ml): neroli, cardamom and cypress, then cashmeran, benzoin and clary sage, over leather, labdanum and patchouli. Darker and more resinous, with leather in place of tobacco.
  • The One Gold for Men Eau de Parfum Intense (£66.54, 100ml): blood orange, Sicilian bergamot and ginger, then clary sage, cardamom and geranium, over amberwood, patchouli and vetiver. Brighter at the start and woodier at the end.

Which The One for him? The eau de parfum for a warm, tobacco-spice scent; the Intense for something darker with leather; The One Gold for a citrus start and a woody finish. All three suit evenings and the colder months.

K by Dolce & Gabbana

The K Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£56.94, 50ml plus a 5ml travel spray) is the fresher choice for men: blood orange, Sicilian lemon and juniper berries, then clary sage, geranium, lavender and fig nectar, over cedarwood, vetiver, patchouli and nagarmotha. Herbal and citrusy, it works for the office and the daytime.

Devotion

Devotion Eau de Parfum (£62.94, 100ml) is a gourmand for women with a short, clear list: candied citrus at the top, orange blossom in the heart and Madagascar vanilla in the base. Sweet, warm and creamy. The Devotion Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£58.99) pairs a 50ml bottle with a 10ml travel spray.

Q by Dolce & Gabbana

Q Eau de Parfum (£70.86, 100ml) is a fruity floral: Sicilian lemon, blood orange and jasmine, then cherry and heliotrope, over cedarwood and musk. Bright and juicy at first, softer and powdery later.

The One for Women and L'Imperatrice

The One for Women Eau de Parfum Gift Set (peach, lychee, mandarin and bergamot; lily, plum and jasmine; vanilla, amber, musk and vetiver) and L'Imperatrice Eau de Toilette (kiwi, rhubarb and pink pepper; watermelon, cyclamen and jasmine; musk, sandalwood and lemon tree) are out of stock at present: use Notify me on the page and we will email you when they are back.

Light Blue and the miniature sets

We do not stock a full bottle of Light Blue at present, but it is in both miniature sets, which are also the easiest way to try the range:

  • Women's Miniature Fragrance Set (£39.99): Devotion, Q, Blue Jasmine (fig, jasmine sambac, cedarwood) and The One in 5ml, plus Light Blue Eau de Toilette 4.5ml (Sicilian lemon, apple, jasmine, cedarwood, musk).
  • Men's Miniature Fragrance Set (£34.99): Devotion, K Eau de Toilette, K Eau de Parfum and The One in 5ml, plus Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Toilette (citrus, juniper, rosemary, musk, woods).

Which Dolce & Gabbana perfume should you choose?

  • A warm, spicy scent for him: The One for Men Eau de Parfum.
  • Darker, with leather: The One for Men Intense.
  • Fresh and herbal for him: K.
  • A sweet vanilla scent for her: Devotion.
  • A fruity floral for her: Q.
  • Light Blue, or not sure yet: one of the miniature sets.

Good to know

  • Eau de parfum, intense or eau de toilette? Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.
  • Buying a gift? See our mini perfume sets guide and perfume gift sets guide.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

nodes.body:
Lalique is a French crystal house, and its perfumes come in bottles that carry that heritage. The scents themselves cover a wide range: berry florals, white flowers, warm vanilla ambers and fresh, spicy scents for men. Every Lalique perfume we stock is a 100ml or 125ml bottle at around £30. Here they are with their notes and who each one suits.

Lalique Amethyst and Amethyst Éclat

  • Lalique Amethyst Eau de Parfum (£31.99, 100ml) is a berry floral: blackcurrant, blackberry, blueberry, mulberry and strawberry at the top, peony, pepper, ylang-ylang and rose in the heart, and musk, woody notes and Bourbon vanilla in the base. Juicy at first, then a soft, warm rose.
  • Lalique Amethyst Éclat Eau de Parfum (£32.99, 100ml) is the lighter version: raspberry, blackcurrant and pear, then peony, rose and magnolia, over blackberry, musk and violet woodsorrel. Fresher and more floral, with less vanilla.

White flowers: L'Amour

Lalique L'Amour Eau de Parfum (£28.99, 100ml) opens with bergamot, neroli and rosebuds, centres on gardenia, tuberose and jasmine, and settles on musk, cedarwood and sandalwood. A bright white-flower bouquet, good for spring, summer and weddings.

Warm and powdery: Perles, Satine and Le Parfum

  • Lalique Perles Eau de Parfum (£31.99, 100ml): Bulgarian rose and orris, then Bourbon pepper and patchouli, over cashmere wood and tonka bean. A soft, powdery rose.
  • Lalique Satine Eau de Parfum (£32.99, 100ml): jasmine, gardenia and heliotrope, then vanilla, tonka bean and pink peppercorn, over patchouli, sandalwood and vetiver. Creamy and warm, an evening and winter scent.
  • Lalique Le Parfum Eau de Parfum (100ml): bay leaf, bergamot and pink peppercorn, then heliotrope and jasmine, over sandalwood, vanilla, patchouli and tonka bean. Out of stock at present: use Notify me on the page.

Lalique de Lalique Eau de Parfum (jasmine, rose, clove flower and orris; blackberry, pear and blackcurrant leaves; sandalwood, vanilla and white musk) is also out of stock at present.

For him: Lalique White

Lalique White Eau de Toilette (£32.99, 125ml) is a fresh, spicy men's scent: lemon tree leaves, bergamot and mandarin, then white pepper, nutmeg, cardamom and violet, over white cedar, white amber, moss and musk. Crisp for the working week, smart enough for evenings. We also list Lalique Lion, L'Insoumis and the Hommage à l'Homme set, which are not available at present.

For anyone: Noir Premier Or Intemporel 1888

Lalique Noir Premier Or Intemporel 1888 Eau de Parfum (£31.99, 100ml) is a unisex amber: bergamot, black pepper and cardamom, then coffee, tobacco and violet, over patchouli, tolu balsam and vanilla. Dark, spiced and warm, for autumn and winter evenings.

Which Lalique perfume should you choose?

  • A fruity floral: Amethyst, or Amethyst Éclat for a lighter take.
  • A white-flower bouquet: L'Amour.
  • A soft, powdery rose: Perles.
  • A creamy vanilla scent: Satine.
  • For him: White.
  • Coffee and tobacco, for anyone: Noir Premier 1888.

If you like Amethyst Éclat's berries and peony, Miss Armaf Chic Eau de Parfum (£29.99, 100ml) pairs raspberry, strawberry, pear and citrus with jasmine, peony and orange blossom over patchouli, cedarwood, musk and vanilla. It is a different perfume, sweeter and juicier.

Good to know

  • Eau de parfum or eau de toilette? Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.
  • Buying a gift? Every Lalique bottle we stock costs under £35: see gifts under £50 and our perfume gift sets guide.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

Lalique is a French crystal house, and its perfumes come in bottles that carry that heritage. The scents themselves cover a wide range: berry florals, white flowers, warm vanilla ambers and fresh, spicy scents for men. Every Lalique perfume we stock is a 100ml or 125ml bottle at around £30. Here they are with their notes and who each one suits.

Lalique Amethyst and Amethyst Éclat

  • Lalique Amethyst Eau de Parfum (£31.99, 100ml) is a berry floral: blackcurrant, blackberry, blueberry, mulberry and strawberry at the top, peony, pepper, ylang-ylang and rose in the heart, and musk, woody notes and Bourbon vanilla in the base. Juicy at first, then a soft, warm rose.
  • Lalique Amethyst Éclat Eau de Parfum (£32.99, 100ml) is the lighter version: raspberry, blackcurrant and pear, then peony, rose and magnolia, over blackberry, musk and violet woodsorrel. Fresher and more floral, with less vanilla.

White flowers: L'Amour

Lalique L'Amour Eau de Parfum (£28.99, 100ml) opens with bergamot, neroli and rosebuds, centres on gardenia, tuberose and jasmine, and settles on musk, cedarwood and sandalwood. A bright white-flower bouquet, good for spring, summer and weddings.

Warm and powdery: Perles, Satine and Le Parfum

  • Lalique Perles Eau de Parfum (£31.99, 100ml): Bulgarian rose and orris, then Bourbon pepper and patchouli, over cashmere wood and tonka bean. A soft, powdery rose.
  • Lalique Satine Eau de Parfum (£32.99, 100ml): jasmine, gardenia and heliotrope, then vanilla, tonka bean and pink peppercorn, over patchouli, sandalwood and vetiver. Creamy and warm, an evening and winter scent.
  • Lalique Le Parfum Eau de Parfum (100ml): bay leaf, bergamot and pink peppercorn, then heliotrope and jasmine, over sandalwood, vanilla, patchouli and tonka bean. Out of stock at present: use Notify me on the page.

Lalique de Lalique Eau de Parfum (jasmine, rose, clove flower and orris; blackberry, pear and blackcurrant leaves; sandalwood, vanilla and white musk) is also out of stock at present.

For him: Lalique White

Lalique White Eau de Toilette (£32.99, 125ml) is a fresh, spicy men's scent: lemon tree leaves, bergamot and mandarin, then white pepper, nutmeg, cardamom and violet, over white cedar, white amber, moss and musk. Crisp for the working week, smart enough for evenings. We also list Lalique Lion, L'Insoumis and the Hommage à l'Homme set, which are not available at present.

For anyone: Noir Premier Or Intemporel 1888

Lalique Noir Premier Or Intemporel 1888 Eau de Parfum (£31.99, 100ml) is a unisex amber: bergamot, black pepper and cardamom, then coffee, tobacco and violet, over patchouli, tolu balsam and vanilla. Dark, spiced and warm, for autumn and winter evenings.

Which Lalique perfume should you choose?

  • A fruity floral: Amethyst, or Amethyst Éclat for a lighter take.
  • A white-flower bouquet: L'Amour.
  • A soft, powdery rose: Perles.
  • A creamy vanilla scent: Satine.
  • For him: White.
  • Coffee and tobacco, for anyone: Noir Premier 1888.

If you like Amethyst Éclat's berries and peony, Miss Armaf Chic Eau de Parfum (£29.99, 100ml) pairs raspberry, strawberry, pear and citrus with jasmine, peony and orange blossom over patchouli, cedarwood, musk and vanilla. It is a different perfume, sweeter and juicier.

Good to know

  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

Armaf is a fragrance house from the United Arab Emirates, and Club de Nuit is its best-known line. It now covers far more than one bottle: the Intense scents for men and women, the Woman eau de parfum, the Precieux extrait and the five Private Key extraits. Here is every Armaf Club de Nuit fragrance we stock, with its notes, the sizes on offer and who each one suits.

Club de Nuit Intense: which one do we stock?

There are two Club de Nuit Intense scents, one for men and one for women, with very different notes. The Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Eau de Parfum (£29.99, 105ml) we stock is the women's version: rose, saffron and geranium at the top, nutmeg, pepper, violet and caraway in the heart, and patchouli, agarwood (oud), vanilla and amber in the base. Spiced rose over a warm, resinous base, for evenings and the colder months. Its notes are the same as the Intense Woman in the women's gift set below.

The men's Club de Nuit Intense Man (lemon, pineapple, bergamot, blackcurrant and apple; birch, jasmine and rose; musk, ambergris, patchouli and vanilla) is in the Club de Nuit Men's Parfum Gift Set, which is out of stock at present: use Notify me on the page and we will email you when it is back.

Club de Nuit Precieux

Armaf Club de Nuit Precieux Extrait de Parfum (£39.99, 55ml) is unisex and the sweetest of the line: pineapple, caramel, pear, pink pepper, bergamot and lemon at the top, oakmoss, white wood, jasmine, anise and lily of the valley in the heart, and ambergris, vanilla, leather, cedar, patchouli and white musk in the base. Fruity and gourmand at first, then smooth and leathery.

The Private Key extraits

The five Private Key scents are unisex extraits de parfum in 100ml bottles at £44.99 each. An extrait holds a higher share of fragrance oils than an eau de parfum; our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.

  • Private Key To My Success: ginger, bergamot and red chilli pepper, then spices and lavender, over akigalawood and vetiver. Spicy and woody.
  • Private Key To My Dreams: pink pepper, cardamom, pineapple leaf and black pepper, then lavender, orange blossom, Bourbon geranium and apple, over leather, vanilla absolute, cedarwood, patchouli and vetiver. Spiced leather and vanilla.
  • Private Key To My Love: peach, pear, passionfruit and cassis, then lily of the valley, white wood and amberwood, over musk, sandalwood, patchouli and vanilla. Fruity and soft.
  • Private Key To My Life: a long citrus and fruit opening (pink pepper, grapefruit, bergamot, lemon, lime, melon, pineapple, plum), then white flowers, lily of the valley, freesia, rose, jasmine and magnolia, over white musk, woods, patchouli, amber and leather. Bright and floral.
  • Private Key To My Soul: grapefruit and mandarin, then sage and lavender, over vanilla. The simplest of the five: fresh herbs and vanilla.

Club de Nuit Woman and the gift sets

  • Club de Nuit Woman Eau de Parfum Travel Set (£26.99, 2 x 12ml): bergamot, grapefruit, peach and orange, then geranium, jasmine, litchi and rose, over musk, patchouli, vanilla and vetiver. A fruity rose, in two handbag sprays.
  • Club de Nuit Women's Parfum Gift Set (£53.99, 3 x 30ml): Club de Nuit Woman, Intense Woman and Milestone (sea notes, red fruits and bergamot; violet, white woods and sandalwood; ambroxan, musk and vetiver).

Which Club de Nuit should you choose?

  • A spiced rose with oud, for her: Club de Nuit Intense (the women's version we stock).
  • Sweet, fruity and leathery, for anyone: Precieux.
  • Spicy and woody: Private Key To My Success.
  • Leather and vanilla: Private Key To My Dreams.
  • Soft and fruity: Private Key To My Love.
  • Fresh herbs and vanilla: Private Key To My Soul.
  • A gift, or not sure yet: the women's 3 x 30ml set or the 2 x 12ml travel set.

Good to know

  • More Arabian perfume: see our Arabian perfume guide and oud perfume guide.
  • Buying a gift? Our perfume gift sets guide has more ideas.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

Shop every Armaf fragrance, or browse Arabian perfume and unisex perfume.

A skincare gift set takes the guesswork out of buying for someone else: the products are chosen to be used together, and the box is ready to give. Here are the skincare gift sets and hair care sets we stock from Vilvah and Deyga, sorted by who they suit, with exactly what is inside each one. Swansura is an official UK partner of both brands, and every kit ships from the UK.

Face care gift sets

  • Vilvah Skin Hydration Kit (£40.99): Milk Face Toner (earth marine water, glycerine, rice milk extract and glycolic acid) and Milk Drops Serum (aloe vera juice, betaine and hyaluronic acid). A simple two-step routine for after cleansing.
  • Vilvah Everyday Care Milk Kit (£48.99): the same toner and serum plus Melt-in-Milk Sunscreen SPF 50, so it covers a full morning routine.
  • Vilvah Milk Face Kit (£44.99): Milk Mud Mask (kaolin, oat milk, saffron and liquorice root extracts) and Milk Drops Serum. A weekly mask and a daily serum.
  • Deyga Healthy Glow Kit (£19.99): a Rose & Mulethi face pack (dried rose petals, mulethi root and oatmeal, mixed with water or toner) and Rose Water Toner. The most affordable face set, and a good one for someone who likes traditional ingredients.

The Milk Face Toner contains glycolic acid, so it suits someone who already uses a toner; patch test first and wear SPF in the day. For more on the serum, see our Vilvah Milk Drops guide.

Body care gift sets

  • Vilvah Milk Body Kit (£41.99): Goat Milk Body Wash (goat milk, coconut-derived cleansers, glycerine and acai oil, scented with vanilla and white lily) and Milk Body Lotion (oat milk, ceramide NP, olive squalane, jojoba and coconut oils). A complete shower-to-moisturiser gift.
  • Vilvah Foot Cream & Body Lotion Kit (£37.99): Foot Care Cream 100ml (shea, mango and avocado butters with argan and kalonji oils) and Milk Body Lotion 250ml. Ideal for someone with dry skin in winter.
  • Vilvah Deo Shot Kit (£17.99): two pocket-size solid deodorant balms, Rose & Vanilla and Lavender & Sage, with kaolin clay and vitamin E.

Lip care gift sets

  • Deyga Nourished Lip Care Kit (£25.99): Strawberry Lip Scrub (sugar in plant oils and shea butter) and the classic Beetroot Lip Balm pot.
  • Deyga Beetroot Lip Balm Stick & Strawberry Lip Scrub combo (£27.99): the same scrub with the tinted beetroot stick.
  • Vilvah Tinted Lip Balm Kit (£17): the Cream Bun and Mango Milkshake lip balms, each with a hint of colour.
  • Vilvah x Annapoorna Gift Box (£20.99): Filter Kaapi and Rose Milk lip balms with Annapoorna coffee beans: two Coimbatore names in one box.

Our lip balm guide and beetroot lip balm guide compare them in more detail.

Hair care gift sets

  • Vilvah Bestseller Hair Kit (£25.99): Goat Milk Shampoo (goat milk, jasmine flower water and hydrolysed pea protein) and Cream Conditioner (tucuma butter, broccoli seed oil and aloe vera).
  • Vilvah Goat Milk Hair Kit (£34.99): Goat Milk Shampoo with the Goat Milk Hair Mask, for a weekly treat.
  • Deyga Daily Use Healthy Hair Combo (from £11.99): Rice Water Shampoo and Soy Milk Conditioner (soybean extract, argan oil, panthenol and vitamin E). The best value hair set we stock.

See our natural shampoo guide for how they compare.

Skincare gifts under £20

For stockings and Secret Santa: the Deyga hair combo (from £11.99), Vilvah Tinted Lip Balm Kit (£17), Deo Shot Kit (£17.99) and Deyga Healthy Glow Kit (£19.99). The Annapoorna box is just over, at £20.99. Our stocking fillers guide has more ideas.

A premium pick

The Highborn London Ultimate Day & Night Moisture Set (£95) holds the Imperial Moisturiser and Night Elixir, both in 50ml jars.

How to choose

  • Not sure of their skin type? Body, lip and hair sets are the safest choice.
  • Check the ingredients: the Deyga beetroot lip balms contain almond oil and beeswax, and the Vilvah goat milk products are not vegan. Every product page has the full ingredient list.
  • Spend £40 or more for free UK delivery: the Deyga Nourished Lip Care Kit and the Vilvah Tinted Lip Balm Kit together come to just over.
  • Delivery before Christmas: see our delivery page for dispatch times and rates.

Shop every skincare gift set, or browse Vilvah and Deyga. Buying perfume too? See our Christmas gift guide.
